screen-sharing.q: Will the teleprompter appear in a Teams screen share or recording?
screen-sharing.a: No. macOS excludes the window from capture, so Teams screen sharing and Teams recordings never include it.

extraFaqs.q: Does it work with the new Teams app and Teams in the browser?
extraFaqs.a: Yes. The exclusion happens at the operating-system level, so it applies to the desktop app and to Teams in any browser.

extraFaqs.q: How do I use a teleprompter with Microsoft Teams?
extraFaqs.a:
1. Open {{APP_NAME}} from the menu bar and start your script from the clipboard.
  2. Place the window near your camera and set the opacity you like.
  3. Join the Teams meeting and share your screen when needed.
  4. Speak; the script keeps pace with you.
